record.question: Protection of 'environment, forests, and wildlife,' which indirectly impacts health is under which list?
record.explanation: Answer C: Concurrent List. Constitution entry 17A and 17B put forests and protection of wild animals and birds in the Concurrent List. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
